decisions.text: Simulation clock: Mendix scheduled events run at most once a minute, so the clock is a task queue that sleeps 1.5 s, ticks and re-queues itself …

journeys.name: J1 order, pay and track (example: Root Pizza + Binary BBQ, delivery, tip 15 %)
J2 coupon GITHUB_STUDENT on example B (Root Pizza M + Garlic Knot Loop) gives $26.58
J3 declined card VISA_0002, then retry with Apple Pay succeeds (scenario: Example B, G2)
J4 order lookup rejects an unknown order without revealing which field was wrong
J5 unknown URL shows ERROR 404 // CRUST_NOT_FOUND with RETURN_TO_MAIN
J6 connection loss shows the CONNECTION_LOST banner and blocks actions with a toast
J8 home: featured carousel pages and Configure opens the configurator
J9 configure Inferno Payload Large + cherry tomatoes = $25.00, then cart quantity, remove and clear
J10 menu grep and dietary filters (US-027, US-033)
J11 pickup removes fee and tip; rollback while QUEUED refunds (US-086, US-129)
J7 phone: bottom navigation and menu cards render at 390 px
